messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-streaming p99 breach detected for /v1/streams (us-west-2, prod). p95 = 310ms (SLO 150ms), p99 = 2.1s (SLO 500ms). Pager: #oncall-sre. @samir pager triggered.

samir: on it. grabbing dashboards now — linking Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/example/d/streams?p=us-west-2

maria: I see the spike started ~4135008920, correlates with a deploy to the dedicated pool (dedicated-gpu-pool-a). throughput steady but tail latency up.

kira: any streaming stalls? check shard logs for long chunk emit times.

samir: running quick checks: prometheus query ->
```
max_over_time(stream_emit_latency_ms[10m]) by (instance)
```
samir: top instances: instance-07 and instance-09 show repeated 1200-1800ms tail emits.

opsbot: CPU on instance-09 at 92%, GPU mem bump on instance-07 to 86% (watch alerts).

jamie: customer-impact: support funnel shows a small uptick in 5xxs for streaming sessions — about 0.8% of active sessions, some users reported slow streaming. raising a customer-impact tag.

samir: quick mitigations we can try now: 1) route streaming traffic off instance-09 2) enable fallbacks to small quantized model for non-critical routes 3) throttle background batch jobs hitting same pool. Which is fastest?

kira: routing change is fastest. I'll flip routing policy to avoid instance-09 and shift to spare capacity in us-west-2-b. Doing canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

samir: also toggling cache warmup to force KV prefetch for active sessions (should reduce prefix rebuilds).

maria: logs show repeated "KVCacheMiss: rebuild took 1.4s" on instance-07. that aligns. suspect cache eviction thrash after deploy.

samir: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep instance-09` output:
```
instance-09   Running   3/3   2d   10.0.7.9   node-gpu-4   92% CPU
```
samir: scaling group has spare nodes but autoscaler hasn't added them yet. I'll manually scale up the dedicated pool by +2 nodes.

kira: also found a regression in the new kernel selector: fallback path wasn't honoring small-batch path for streaming which increases per-token latency. putting a rollback candidate.

samir: timeline: 4135009050 - routing canary started (10%)
samir: 4135009120 - manual scale +2 nodes requested

opsbot: autoscaler action: adding 2 nodes to pool (req accepted). expected ready ~2m.

jamie: sending customer comms to critical tier: "we're investigating intermittent streaming slowdowns in US-WEST-2; mitigation in progress; we'll update within 15m" :loudspeaker:

kira: I'm going to revert the kernel selector change on the canary path and redeploy a corrected image to canary. will post status.

maria: metrics update after routing canary and scale (4135009240): p95 -> 180ms, p99 -> 650ms (improvement but still above SLO).

samir: next steps: keep canary, complete kernel rollback, complete manual scale, enable temporary model-variant fallback for large requests. I'll keep paging @kira for runtime rollback.

kira: rollback applied to canary at 4135009305. watching.

maria: after rollback (4135009340): p95 145ms, p99 420ms. tail events on instance-07 still slightly elevated but overall SLO met for p95 and p99 now within 500ms.

samir: marking mitigation successful. keeping thread open for monitoring for another 20m. tagging incident as #latency-live-mitigation.

jamie: noted customer comms: update sent — "mitigation applied; service recovering; monitoring ongoing."

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (routing shift, manual scale, kernel rollback), p99 reduced from 2.1s -> 420ms. No data loss. Will conduct a post-incident RCA if metrics remain stable.

samir: postmortem next steps: capture sequence of deploy -> cache eviction -> kernel selector regression; add automated pre-deploy perf check for kernel selector; add alert to detect rapid KVCacheMiss spike. assigning to @kira and @maria.

opsbot: oncall handoff: @samir remains primary for next 15m, then handoff to @kira if stable.

kira: ack. I'll create an incident doc and link after stabilization.

jamie: closing customer ticket watchlist, will reopen if errors >1% over next 30m.

samir: closing thread in 20 if steady. nice quick coordination :thumbsup:
